title: Semidirect-Product Structure ℤ/4 ⋊ ℤ/2 of the D₄ Galois Action

problemStatement.formal: Exhibit the splitting-field Galois group of X⁴−2 over ℚ (order 8) as the internal/external semidirect product ℤ/4 ⋊ ℤ/2: a normal order-4 rotation subgroup and an order-2 reflection acting by inversion.
problemStatement.plain: The Galois group of X⁴−2 over ℚ has order 8, but order alone does not fix its isomorphism type. Make the dihedral structure ℤ/4 ⋊ ℤ/2 explicit.
